title: Enabling Upcoming Features Ahead of Time

facts.text: Generally available. Features listed in Feature Management are ready and follow standard support lifecycle for their service update.
Sign in and navigate to the Feature Management page, or use link businesscentral.dynamics.com/?page=2610.
If the page isn't editable, choose the Edit List action.
For the feature you want to enable, choose All users in the Enabled for field.
Assign the FEATURE MGT. - ADMIN permission set to give users permission to enable upcoming features. Introduced in version 18.1.
Optional features typically become mandatory in a later major update. Check the Automatically enabled from field for the expected date.
Irreversible features permanently affect system state and can't be turned off after enabling. A warning dialog appears before enabling on production.
Features apply to all users in the environment. Business Central doesn't allow enabling a feature for a single user or group.
